title: Slovakian Keto Toast Casserole
description: A twist on traditional Slovakian cuisine, this keto casserole is made with tangy cheese, crispy bacon, and toasted bread.

ingredients.name: Slovakian Cheese (Pirohy Cheese)
ingredients.notes: Available at some European grocery stores or online

ingredients.name: Tangy Cheese (such as Feta or Goat Cheese)
Herbs (optional)
ingredients.notes: such as chopped parsley or chives

instructions: Cube the bread into small pieces and toast until crispy.
Cook the bacon in a pan until crispy and set aside.
In a large bowl, mix together the Slovakian cheese, tangy cheese, egg, and chopped onion.
Add the toasted bread, crispy bacon, and herbs (if using) to the bowl and mix until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
